description:
How many people were dispensed an antidepressant each financial year from 2015-16 to 2024-25, as a count and per 1,000 residents, plus the prescriptions dispensed, for Australia and each state and territory.

Coverage: Australia and all 8 states and territories; financial years 2015-16 to 2024-25. Current to 2025-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/antidepressant-use`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: patients, patients_per_1000, prescriptions, prescriptions_per_1000. Omit for all.

state.description: State or territory abbreviation: nsw, vic, qld, sa, wa, tas, act or nt.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: states_health_antidepressant_use
title: State · Antidepressant use
